planSteps.description: Stay on the page that is already open at the start URL and do not navigate to any other address: the chart is on that page. Wait 4 seconds for the chart to settle
Click the 'TestSprite view' button in the top bar
Verify a strip at the bottom reads 'Sensor view. N parts found.' where N is a whole number greater than 0
Verify the strip reports how many of the 24 letters it can find inside the chart canvas
